maker: Mirai Kikai Inc. (未来機械株式会社)
name: Mirai Kikai HOKUSAI marking robot
summary: Small self-driving layout robot from Kagawa, Japan, that draws reference lines, shapes and text from the drawing onto the floor, guided in real time by a Leica 3D Disto laser measuring device. Works for 6 hours per charge and can finish the marking overnight for the next day's trades.

germany.statusNote: Offered in Japan only, by the maker (contact form) and, under the name SUMIDAS, as a rental robot from the Japanese rental firm Rental no Nikken with near-identical figures. No German or EU seller or CE information found.
